characterList.description: A young woman with brown, shoulder-length hair, wearing a blue denim shirt and a silver necklace with a feather pendant. Host and narrator of the video.
characterList.name: Brittany Wang

content_metadata.description: Brittany Wang hosts a video explaining the Kindle read-aloud feature and its applications in book editing and writing.

qAndA.answer: The commenter, Fiction Technician, said, 'Very helpful video, Brittany! I like to have the Kindle read my book to me, so I can review it while I watch my kids at the park. Multi-tasking!'.
qAndA.question: What was the specific comment that led Brittany to discover the read-aloud feature?

qAndA.answer: Brittany exclaimed, 'Wait!!! Kindle can read your book to you?? :D I can't believe I missed that! haha What do you click to make that happen? That's so cool!'.
qAndA.question: What was Brittany's reaction when she realized Kindle could read books aloud?

qAndA.answer: Brittany chose an Australian accent voice.
qAndA.question: What type of voice did Brittany ultimately choose for the read-aloud feature?

qAndA.answer: The novel is titled 'On Wings of Ash & Dust'.
qAndA.question: What is the name of Brittany's upcoming novel, as shown on the Kindle app?

qAndA.answer: Sometimes the voice would combine two sentences as one, even though there was a period separating them. To fix it, Brittany uses the hand controller and taps the page where she wants the reading to start.
qAndA.question: What specific issue did Brittany encounter with the read-aloud feature, and how did she fix it?

youtube_description:
How would you like to listen to your novel read to you (finished or not!) like it's an audiobook?? Did you know you could do this by using the Kindle App on your phone?? Fellow authortuber, Fiction Technician, was the sweetest in giving me all the steps so I could try it out myself and share the steps with you! Listen to what it sounds like to have my Kindle App read the first page of my YA fantasy "On Wings of Ash and Dust" and learn how to do the same with any book in your Kindle library (including any books you've written!)
